notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 Next Message Request service. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies selection and delivery of the next queued timestamped interaction before the requested grant, callback ordering, logical-time and retraction metadata, and the standard no-longer-retractable boundary without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador nextMessageRequest with timestamped interaction delivery and FederateAmbassador callbacks
